implementationRevision: 78f4cfc (feature/goz-0007-immutable-revisions); uncommitted working-tree changes were demo evidence only. Tests and demo not re-run by the analyst (cumulative demo queued by drive-speckit); make validate passed after the prompt edits.

findings.title: Revision contract v1: routes and check order, immutability for every login, SemVer-precedence uniqueness with no latest, closed statement v1 (RFC 8785 + raw Ed25519), digests, computed verification and bounded reasons, no update/delete or verify endpoint
findings.recommendation: Record the contract in every dependent prompt; any member change is statement v2.

findings.title: Pins after GOZ-0007: migration 20261121000000_ManifestRevisions, five tables, is_operator(), 8 migrations, 27 scoped endpoints / 22 actions / 6 resources, manifest.validate moved to manifest resource, boundary test allows four tables, goz-0007 project, permanent demo revisions on manifest-demo
findings.recommendation: Supersede the GOZ-0006 counts and pins in every prompt.

findings.title: Telemetry, audit and limits: gozleme.manifest.publish/verify spans, publications/verifications counters with bounded labels, gozleme.ui.manifest_publish, audit 1501-1504 (range 1501-1510 held; next module 1601), PublishPerMinute 10 in PostgreSQL, succession span
findings.recommendation: Supersede '1501-1510 still free'; record names and the separate budget.

findings.title: Recorded-not-attested fields (SEC-1): publishedBy, rule-catalogue and schema-bundle versions, family and envelope title/summary are stored and shown but outside statement v1
findings.recommendation: Never present them as signed; signing them is a new statement version. Specific notes in 0013, 0019, 0021, 0030.

findings.title: Key custody limit (maintainer Q1): registry-held per-publisher Ed25519 keys under an AES-256-GCM KEK with AD context||publisher||keyId; key.id = sha256(raw public key); attestation proves origin acceptance, not a publisher-held key; fixed proof wording
evidence: progress.yaml decisions key-custody, signing-library, signed-bytes; A2
findings.recommendation: Record the limit; downstream wording never says 'publisher signature'. Specific notes in 0019, 0029, 0030, 0039.

findings.title: Operator-only add-only key succession (lost|compromised, --undecryptable); retired keys still verify; database refuses attestations by retired keys; no rotation API, revocation or peer trust
findings.recommendation: Route rotation to 0039, revocation to 0033, peer trust of a succession to 0029.

findings.title: Insert guards fire for every login (superuser included): they overwrite published_at/created_at/retired_at with now(), demand a local capability/publisher, a gap-free local sequence and is_operator() for generation > 1. A trigger-enabled data restore would re-time revisions (statement_mismatch) and refuse successor keys; imports cannot use the local revision tables
evidence: Inferred from code; restore not reproduced (no stack run by analyst)
findings.recommendation: 0039: restore with --disable-triggers or physical backup and prove every revision still verifies; back up the KEK separately. 0030-0032/0036: store imported revisions in their own tables with foreign bytes verbatim.

findings.title: Revision identity: statement identifies a revision by origin + capability + version (+ sequence); the revision UUID is local and unattested; no latest designation; any-order versions
findings.recommendation: Key portable records on attested members; 0012/0013/0022 clarify which revision they surface.

findings.title: Projection digest defined: sha256 over RFC 8785 canonical projection v1 bytes (the stored bytes), attested with projection.version and adapter {id, version}; resolves the GOZ-0007 part of GOZ-0006-IF-08
findings.recommendation: Supersede the 0028 'needs a defined canonical form' bullet.

findings.title: Revisions, downloads, key list and PEM key are org-private member reads (manifest.list/manifest.read, A5); no public or peer route
findings.recommendation: Add explicit grant/peer routes; never widen the org-scoped ones.

findings.title: Suspension blocks publishing (handler and write policy); revisions stay readable/verifiable; no lifecycle state; no delete for any login, so retention cannot purge
findings.recommendation: Revocation/withdrawal are additive records; any purge needs a maintainer decision.

findings.title: GOZ-0005-IF-08 (permanent suspension) can now be decided with known GOZ-0007 semantics
findings.recommendation: Note in 0039; decision stays open for the maintainer.

findings.title: Signing building blocks (CanonicalJson, Ed25519Signer, vault) are reusable, but which key signs lockfiles (0028) and grants (0034) is a custody decision; publisher revision keys sign gozleme.revision-attestation only
findings.recommendation: Maintainer decision at each spec's clarify; distinct type and AD context if reused.
findings.disposition: applied (routed to maintainer decision at clarify)

findings.title: GOZ-0005-IF-04 trigger fired: GOZ-0007 adds a second owner-login operator command (signing-key-succession) and hard-codes gozleme_migrator in is_operator(), while IF-04 (least-privilege operator role) says decide 'earlier if a spec adds another owner-login operator command'. The GOZ-0007 workspace does not reference IF-04
findings.recommendation: Maintainer: decide GOZ-0005-IF-04 now, or explicitly defer it again to GOZ-0039 accepting the second command. Not edited by the analyst.
findings.disposition: resolved by maintainer ruling 2026-11-18: second owner-login command accepted for MVP; GOZ-0005-IF-04 stays open until GOZ-0039 clarification

findings.title: Governance documents do not record the GOZ-0007 custody decision: architecture-baseline.md:19 lists MVP 'authenticated publisher identity/signatures', and decision-register.md has no entry for Q1 (registry-held keys, stated limit), Q5 (succession), P1/P2 or the SEC-1 recorded-not-attested ruling
evidence: progress.yaml decisions key-custody, key-succession, P1, P2
findings.recommendation: Maintainer: approve an additive amendment (decision-register entry and baseline note that MVP publisher signatures are registry-held per-publisher keys with the stated limit). Not edited by the analyst.
findings.disposition: resolved by maintainer approval 2026-11-18: decision-register entries (IF-15, SEC-1, IF-14) and architecture-baseline MVP line amended
